outcome: distribution of patients among labor induction categories
proportion of patients undergoing cesarean section
cohort: The study included 819 patients who underwent labor induction for common indications such as post-term pregnancy, premature rupture of membranes, and gestational diabetes.
finding: The study found significant differences in patient distribution across categories between the Nippita and Grenoble classification systems, suggesting that the Grenoble classification may offer a more suitable framework for standardizing labor induction procedures.
mod_finding: Differences were identified in the proportion of patients who underwent cesarean section across homogeneous categories when comparing the Nippita and Grenoble classification systems.
